description.en: A forest retreat where the page grows overhead — canopy layers darken as you scroll deeper, dappled light filters through. The third organic-nature, distinct from sup and dream.
description.ko: A forest retreat where the page grows overhead — canopy layers darken as you scroll deeper, dappled light filters through. The third organic-nature, distinct from sup and dream.

provenance.en: The far canopy layer is a single generated painterly forest photo — ComfyUI on the Illustrious checkpoint bismuthIllustrious_v80 at 1536x640, 30 steps, CFG 5.5, encoded to AVIF + WebP (~200 KB). It is darkened to 42% opacity and tinted so it reads as atmosphere behind the CSS leaf shapes, which remain code. Full recipe in PROMPT.md image-recipe.
provenance.ko: 멀리 수관 레이어 한 장은 생성된 그림풍 숲 사진 — ComfyUI의 Illustrious 계열 체크포인트 bismuthIllustrious_v80, 1536x640, 30스텝, CFG 5.5, AVIF + WebP 인코딩(약 200KB). 코드로 그린 잎 모양 뒤에 대기로 읽히도록 42% 불투명도로 어둡게 하고 틴트를 입혔다. 전체 레시피는 PROMPT.md의 image-recipe에.
